name: Besta
title: Western Liberators
description: An assault trooper of the Western Liberators. She carries out missions with unwavering dedication, no matter the circumstances, so she is highly regarded by the warriors of the west.
introduction:
An assault trooper of the Western Liberators.
She is known for carrying out her duties without complaint in any situation and always fulfilling her role.

Besta's taciturn nature and brief speech reinforce her image as a model warrior who is focused solely on the Liberators' mission.
She is highly trusted by her commander Ceres, but for some reason seems to be watched warily by the operations officer Lydia, who often takes another route when Besta approaches from a distance.
It is said within the Liberators that Lydia visibly shows discomfort whenever Besta appears during conversations between Ceres and Lydia, and this is generally understood as a subtle rivalry between Lydia's strategizing and Besta's brute force.

There are also rumors that her frequent nosebleeds may be due to an excessive workload.
